instructions: Shred both cheeses on the large holes of a box grater into a large bowl. That should be about 2 cups of the sharp cheddar and 1 cup of the mild.
Drain the pimentos well in a sieve, then add them to the bowl. Add the mayonnaise, Dijon, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper.
Stir with a fork until everything is coated and holds together. Taste it, and add a pinch more salt or pepper if it needs it.
Lay out 4 slices of bread. Spread about 1/4 inch of the pimento cheese over each slice, out to the edges, and top with the other 4 slices.

Cut each sandwich in half on the diagonal. This makes more spread than 4 sandwiches use. Cover the rest and keep it in the fridge for up to 5 days. Packed sandwiches keep in an airtight container for up to 2 days. The spread doesn't freeze well.
method_notes: Insanely Good Recipes is the lead (4.8 out of 5 from only 8 ratings), so this is a fallback lead. The other versions read (Cook What You Love, Our Zesty Life, Everyday Elizabeth) all combine shredded cheddar, mayonnaise and jarred pimentos with garlic and onion powder; they differ in whether cream cheese goes in and in how much heat. This follows the lead without the optional cream cheese, cayenne and hot sauce, so the base is mild. Put hot sauce on the table for the adults.
